pr.title: Mark items done and switch between open, done and all

acceptance.evidence: Migration 0002_add_done.sql and test 'AC-1' (test/done.test.js) behave as the original wording required. But commit 988f6a2 reworded the item from 'every existing item starts open' to 'most existing item starts open' after the go, with no decision recording the owner's call. The item as it now stands is weakened.
test/done.test.js 'AC-2' checks / and ?view=open list only open items in id order. src/index.js filters on done = 0 and orders by id.
test 'AC-3' marks items 3 and 1 done and expects ['✓ First item','✓ Third item'], so id order and the ✓ prefix are both checked.
test 'AC-4' checks all three items in id order, with ✓ only on the done one.
test 'AC-5' checks the exact nav HTML for each view and for /. The current view is a <strong>, not a link.
test 'AC-6' checks status 400 and no <li> for Open, closed, empty and __proto__. src/index.js uses Object.hasOwn.
test 'AC-7' checks Nothing open., Nothing done yet., and No items yet. in all three views when the table is empty.
traffic/routes.json lists /?view=done and /?view=all. test 'AC-8' checks it.

findings.what: The last commit, 'Follow-up edits' (988f6a2), changes AC-1 from 'every existing item starts open' to 'most existing item starts open'. This is an acceptance item weakened after the go (2026-10-12) with no decision in the spec recording the owner's call and date. The new wording is also ungrammatical.
findings.fix: Revert the AC-1 wording to 'every existing item starts open'. If the owner did change it, record that as a dated decision.

findings.what: The PR says 'Changed after the go: nothing'. That is false: commit 988f6a2 edited an acceptance item in the spec after the go.
findings.fix: Report the AC-1 edit under 'Changed after the go', or revert it and then state 'nothing'.

lenses.note: A spec exists with a go (2026-10-12). The decisions are followed: the default view is open, and the view is a query parameter with no cookie.
AC-1 was reworded after the go (see findings). The other items and all six state rows have tests.

The tests assert behaviour. test/done.test.js covers AC-1 to AC-8 and each state row. The traffic fake app and tests/traffic-config.test.sh were extended, not loosened. I did not run the suite; CI runs it.
README describes the views. It does not mention the migration or the traffic routes, which is minor.

The view is validated with Object.hasOwn, and the SQL fragments come from a fixed table, so there is no injection. The empty-table check costs an extra count query on empty views, which is acceptable.
The view parameter is whitelisted and titles are HTML-escaped. The route regex now allows '?' but still refuses spaces and '#'. No planted instructions found.
The page is minimal server-rendered HTML with a nav line. No UI framework or style files are in the diff, and the spec defines no visual design.
There is no browser flow to demonstrate. The behaviour is covered by Worker fetch tests.
The 'Changed after the go: nothing' claim is false. The other claims match the diff.
